concerns.text: The Constitution (Principle III – Data Hygiene) requires that downloaded datasets be checksummed and the checksum recorded under `data/`. No task in Phase 2 (or elsewhere) implements checksum verification for the GSM8K download (T009). Add a task (e.g., T0XX) that computes SHA‑256 checksums of the downloaded files, stores them in `data/checksums.txt`, and validates them before any downstream use.

Specification SC‑003 and SC‑004 demand that each individual experimental run respect the RAM (≤ 7 GB) and wall‑clock (≤ 6 h) limits. The current tasks only provide an overall CI metric check (T031, T033) and lack a concrete test that fails if any single run exceeds these limits. Add a verification task (e.g., T0YY) that asserts per‑run resource usage against the limits, integrated into the resource‑monitor utility and CI contract tests.
